text:
aisha: Heads-up — our nightly SAST run started spiking KMS decrypt errors for evidence attachments. Seeing 429s from keystore service around 01:05 UTC. Anyone else?
jonah: saw it too, looks like parallel scan jobs all hitting ephemeral-keystore at once. KMS has soft rate limits.
kevin: Are these from GHA runners or from the scanner fleet? If runners, we can add jitter/queue. If fleet, we need a circuit breaker in the scanner service.
aisha: GHAs — we fan out ~40 parallel jobs. When they upload evidence to s3 with envelope keys we call keystore decrypt per artifact.
lena: quick mitigation: add per-run token caching + backoff. Also audit logs: right now keystore log only shows 'decrypt' with no request_id. Would like trace id so we can correlate.
sec-bot: alert: nightly-sast: run 2745012345 had 37/120 decrypt errors (categorized as throttling). Link: https://redwood.internal/scan/runs/2745012345
jonah: proposed config snippet:
```
env:
  SCAN_CONCURRENCY: 8
  KEY_CACHE_TTL: "10m"
  KEY_CACHE_MAX: 50
```
kevin: I can land a GH action change to reduce concurrency + add soft jitter. Also will add request_id header "X-Trace-Id" to decrypt call.
aisha: great — two asks: 1) can we change keystore audit log to include X-Trace-Id and actor? 2) add a SAST failure classifier to mark throttling vs actual vuln.
lena: for (1) infra change, tagging @infra-oncall. For (2) devs can add rule in scan-processor: if error.code == 'THROTTLE' mark remediation = 'retry' not vuln.
jonah: created ticket INFRA-2245 to include trace_id and user-agent in keystore logs. pinged infra.
kevin: opened PR #1289 to GH actions with reduced concurrency + header. CC @aisha for verification.
aisha: I'll run a quick patch on a branch and post results. Thanks :thumbsup: 
lena: also, let's add a postmortem template point — how scan pacing maps to audit noise. small note in runbook.
aisha: closing loop — after PR merged, we dropped decrypt errors to 2 in next run. Keeping change for next week. Marking as resolved.
